```yaml
name: Discover new CLAUDE.md files

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install requests

      - name: Discover CLAUDE.md files
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os, sys, json, requests, time

          token = os.getenv('GITHUB_TOKEN')
          headers = {
              'Authorization': f'token {token}',
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json'
          }

          query = 'CLAUDE.md in:file language:md'
          per_page = 30
          page = 1
          known_file = '.github/claude_known.json'

          # Load known repos
          if os.path.exists(known_file):
              with open(known_file) as f:
                  known = set(json.load(f))
          else:
              known = set()

          while True:
              url = f'https://api.github.com/search/code?q={query}&per_page={per_page}&page={page}'
              r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
              if r.status_code != 200:
                  print(f'Error: {r.status_code} {r.text}', file=sys.stderr)
                  sys.exit(1)
              data = r.json()
              items = data.get('items', [])
              if not items:
                  break

              for item in items:
                  repo_full_name = item['repository']['full_name']
                  if repo_full_name in known:
                      continue

                  issue_title = f'New CLAUDE.md candidate: {repo_full_name}'
                  issue_body = f"Repository: https://github.com/{repo_full_name}\n\nFile: {item['html_url']}\n\nPlease review and add to the collection if relevant."
                  issue_url = f'https://api.github.com/repos/{os.getenv("GITHUB_REPOSITORY")}/issues'
                  issue_resp = requests.post(
                      issue_url,
                      headers=headers,
                      json={
                          'title': issue_title,
                          'body': issue_body,
                          'labels': ['enhancement', 'automation']
                      }
                  )
                  if issue_resp.status_code == 201:
                      print(f'Issue created for {repo_full_name}')
                      known.add(repo_full_name)
                  else:
                      print(f'Failed to create issue for {repo_full_name}: {issue_resp.status_code} {issue_resp.text}', file=sys.stderr)

              if 'next' in r.links:
                  page += 1
                  time.sleep(1)  # Respect rate limits
              else:
                  break

          # Save updated known repos
          with open(known_file, 'w') as f:
              json.dump(list(known), f, indent=2)
          PY

      - name: Commit known repos file
        if: success()
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .github/claude_known.json
          git commit -m "Update known CLAUDE.md repos" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push
```
